Manchester City Found Guilty of Financial Rule Breaches

Manchester City has reportedly been found guilty of breaching Premier League financial rules, with charges related to 115 offenses. All but one charge has reportedly been upheld. The specific punishment for these breaches is still pending. The club has responded to the developments.
